parameters.query:
SELECT id, message
FROM ai_agent_metadata
WHERE session_id = $1
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3;

INSERT INTO ai_agent_metadata (session_id, message)
VALUES (
  $1,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'type', 'human',
    'content', CASE
                 WHEN $2 = '' OR convert_from(decode($2, 'base64'), 'UTF8') = U&'\200B'
                 THEN ''
                 ELSE convert_from(decode($2, 'base64'), 'UTF8')
               END,
    'additional_kwargs', jsonb_build_object(
      'action',    $3::text,
      'files',     convert_from(decode($4, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb,
      'timestamp', $5::bigint
    ),
    'response_metadata', '{}'::jsonb
  )
);
